header:
# Town of Shoreham municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 21; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a moderator for a one-year term

Town of Shoreham, Official Return of Votes, Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (191 voters; certified by Town Clerk Laura Siebecker), published on the town website shorehamvt.us: the 2026 moderator contest had no ballot candidate; the write-in plurality (Jonathan Hescock, 78) does not seat, so the post stands without a membership (flagged on issue #163)

Town of Shoreham, 2024 Annual Report, elected and appointed town officers tables: the Town Clerk is filed under Appointed Town Officers, and the office appeared on neither the 2025 warning's ballot list nor the 2026 ballot -- Shoreham has converted the clerk to an appointed office (17 V.S.A. section 2651e pattern). Laura Siebecker signs the 2026 return as Town Clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Laura Siebecker as Shoreham's Town Clerk
Town of Shoreham, 2024 Annual Report, elected and appointed town officers tables: the Town Treasurer is filed under Appointed Town Officers (17 V.S.A. section 2651f pattern)
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Carol Murphy as Shoreham's Town Treasurer

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists Shoreham's five selectboard members: Stephen Goodrich (Chair), Rebecca Kerr (Vice Chair), Peter Lynch, Mark Spitzner, and Loren Wood

Town of Shoreham, Official Return of Votes, Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (191 voters; certified by Town Clerk Laura Siebecker), published on the town website shorehamvt.us: Rebecca Kerr was re-elected (166 votes), Peter Lynch re-elected to a three-year term (172), and Mark Spitzner elected (163); Molly Francis departed

offices.title: Lister
offices.org_name: Town of Shoreham Board of Listers

sources.note: 17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a board of listers of three
Town of Shoreham, 2024 Annual Report, elected and appointed town officers tables: Phil Kivlin holds a lister term to 2027

Town of Shoreham, Official Return of Votes, Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (191 voters; certified by Town Clerk Laura Siebecker), published on the town website shorehamvt.us: the 2026 lister contest drew only three scattered write-in votes against 188 blanks, which never seats; the second seat (an appointee's expiring term) and the third (already vacant) stand unfilled
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect auditors (three, staggered terms) unless the office is eliminated
Town of Shoreham, 2024 Annual Report, elected and appointed town officers tables: Maureen Gour holds an auditor term to 2027

Town of Shoreham, Official Return of Votes, Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (191 voters; certified by Town Clerk Laura Siebecker), published on the town website shorehamvt.us: both 2026 auditor contests (three-year term and one-year remainder) drew only scattered write-ins, which never seat

Town of Shoreham, 2024 Annual Report, elected and appointed town officers tables: the report's elected table lists a seven-member elected Planning Commission; Caroline Paske holds a term to 2028. The four seats filled at the 2025 meeting are published nowhere, so their holders are held as stragglers (flagged on issue #163)

Town of Shoreham, Official Return of Votes, Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (191 voters; certified by Town Clerk Laura Siebecker), published on the town website shorehamvt.us: Carrie Marini was re-elected (150 votes), Timothy Steady elected (164), and Peter Lynch elected to a one-year remainder (168)
Town of Shoreham, 2024 Annual Report, elected and appointed town officers tables: Tanya Scuteri holds a library term to 2027, Cora Waag (Chair) to 2028, and Katie Flagg to 2029

Town of Shoreham, Official Return of Votes, Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (191 voters; certified by Town Clerk Laura Siebecker), published on the town website shorehamvt.us: Laura Siebecker was re-elected a library trustee (168 votes) and Susan Spitzner elected (175). The return labels the two 2026 seats four-year and three-year terms, which does not square with the report's five-year stagger; the discrepancy is flagged on issue #163
Town of Shoreham, 2024 Annual Report, elected and appointed town officers tables: the Tri-Town Water Commissioners are elected; Lance Wood holds a term to 2027

Town of Shoreham, Official Return of Votes, Annual Town Meeting, March 3, 2026 (191 voters; certified by Town Clerk Laura Siebecker), published on the town website shorehamvt.us: Brian R. Treadway was elected a Tri-Town Water Commissioner (172 votes); the third seat's 2025 outcome is unpublished (straggler)
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a constable

Town of Shoreham, 2024 Annual Report, elected and appointed town officers tables: the constable seat is printed vacant, and the office did not appear on the 2026 ballot, so the post stands without a membership
